notes: Card: top examples are discipline words inside proper names of research bodies and journals (Circulatory Physiology, Science Technology and Industry Policy Papers, Max Planck Institute for Developmental Biology, Hydrology and Remote Sensing Laboratory, Directorate for Engineering, Center for Chemistry Education); ' Comparative' x3. Near misses use the same discipline words in ordinary prose, so the test separates the context from the word.
